result: For EVERY complex theta=(v0,v1,v2,lambda) satisfying max_j |theta_j-1/4|<=2^-158, the normalized 4x4 state obtained by the explicit local map below is PPT, entangled and has Schmidt number exactly 2. This supplies a nonzero explicit radius for the previously existential full-support projection patch. The tiny bound is deliberately conservative, not claimed optimal. This is a proper local family of projections of one 4x5 state, not a theorem for every 4x4 PPT state.
map_and_base: K_theta|0,1,2>=|0,1,2>, K_theta|3>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>+lambda|3>, K_theta|4>=|3>. The source is the explicit 4x5 R in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9, with R>=0 and R^Gamma>=0. The 761-positive-atom exact theta0 decomposition certificate SHA256 1f7f538778997943743648f17169fcd2eceea139896d3a827640dd4adc8baa2c and its independent physical replay SHA256 442071944f809a6ab55ba0b437cb9224e0354df8888a6bc7910395b19cc1c9be are detailed in frontier-20261028-grid-full-support-sn2-v1.json SHA256 588998c1083ae59fa660f82d15494a4c3b475da46ce8e6c22508ebe1ee321b79.
chart_atoms: The 753 nonbasis atoms have fixed exact Gaussian-rational alpha,beta,b,f with alpha*f!=0; the remaining 8 are constant SR<=2 source generators. For theta, put d=v1*f-alpha*b-beta, c=(1+v2*f-beta*b)/alpha, e=alpha+beta*d-v0*f, h=lambda*f/alpha, gamma=(lambda*e+c)/h, delta=v1*e-gamma*b, i=gamma*c+delta*b-v2*e, g=gamma+delta*d-v0*e, xi=(1,b,c,d,e,f,g,i,h). The projected coefficient matrix has row2=alpha row0+beta row1 and row3=gamma row0+delta row1. Each atom is scaled by its fixed certified positive integer base factor and divided by its fixed base coefficient norm, so its theta0 coefficient vector has norm1. Chart parameters and base matching were checked for all atoms in frontier-20261028-grid-generic-open-basis-check.py SHA256 0944f0cebaea48423e62c8949f12d1e006c5ab6f2fdaa3574bc5aeb8fc9d73b2.
exact_matrix_bounds: Let A(theta) be the 81x761 real Hermitian-Gram-coordinate matrix of these normalized atoms, d=diag(1,1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3), and let B(theta) be the 81 selected columns listed in frontier-20261028-grid-generic-open-basis-v1.json SHA256 c65ff38a925a768b4c0fc0d19aa7ebc4633f0dbb3152c4abff7fe7b944936a40. The exact normalized base weights w0 satisfy A(theta0)w0=d, each w0_j>2^-18, and sum_j w0_j=Tr(d)=21. A rational matrix X=P/10^10 is provided by frontier-20261028-grid-normalized-inverse-v1.json SHA256 3ecbbeefa5e6114027190774a520bf93d8941936869907ae2d84bd987d7d9a8f. The independent integer checker establishes ||X||_infinity<2^10 and |(X B(theta0)-I)_ij|<1/162 for every one of 6561 entries. Thus ||I-XB(theta0)||_infinity<1/2 and ||B(theta0)^(-1)||_infinity<2^11. The numerical inverse was ONLY a proposal; these bounds use exact integer inequalities.
uniform_chart_bound: The exact checker verifies all chart parameters obey |alpha|,|beta|,|b|,|f|,|alpha|^-1,|f|^-1<=C=64. On the polydisc max_j|theta_j-theta0_j|<=1/8, |v_i|<1, |lambda|>=1/8, so direct triangle estimates give |d|<=3C^2, |c|<=3C^3, |e|<=5C^3, |h|<=C^2, |h|^-1<=8C^2, |gamma|<=64C^5, |delta|<=69C^6, |i|<=266C^8, |g|<=276C^8. The fixed normalization factor is at most1 because every normalized chart atom's a-coordinate before normalization is 1. Hence each normalized coefficient has modulus <=S=300C^8<2^57 throughout that polydisc. They are holomorphic there because lambda,alpha,f are nonzero.
quantitative_continuity_proof: For max_j|theta_j-theta0_j|<=epsilon=2^-158, Cauchy's one-variable derivative estimate on discs of radius1/16 inside the above 1/8-polydisc gives a derivative bound 16S in each coordinate; varying four coordinates gives each atom coefficient change <=64S epsilon. Each real or imaginary Gram feature therefore changes by at most L epsilon, where L=128S^2<2^121. Consequently ||B(theta)-B(theta0)||_infinity<=81L epsilon, and ||B(theta0)^(-1)(B(theta)-B(theta0))||_infinity<2^(11+7+121-158)=2^-19<1/2. Neumann's lemma yields ||B(theta)^(-1)||_infinity<2^12. Hold all nonselected normalized base weights fixed, solve the selected weights so A(theta)w(theta)=d, and subtract the base equation. Since sum_j w0_j=21, ||w_B(theta)-w_B(theta0)||_infinity<=2^12*21*L*epsilon<2^(12+5+121-158)=2^-20. Every selected base weight exceeds 2^-18, so every corrected weight remains positive; all fixed weights remain positive. This is a concrete finite SR<=2 decomposition for every theta in the closed 2^-158 polydisc, with weights defined by the displayed linear system.
entanglement: On the same polydisc v1 remains nonzero and |v1|,|v2|<=5/16. The actual projected 3x3 core obeys the product-minor/Cauchy necessary condition for separability 4<=3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2), proved in frontier-20261028-grid-generic-open-neighborhood-v1.json SHA256 31918eaac7a525c3482fdde7e2512c70bbdbeca3bbc5bda1cbc242f7b7d27201. Here 3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2)<=150/256<4. Thus every core is entangled and so is its parent; the positive SR<=2 decomposition gives SN exactly2. Local congruence preserves the source PPT certificate, and positive trace permits normalization.

independent_exact_bound_check.actual: 761 normalized weights all strictly greater than 2^-18; exact parameter upper/reciprocal bound C=64; rational proposed inverse infinity norm <2^10; all 6561 exact residual entries strictly below 1/162; therefore exact basis inverse norm <2^11. All checks use integer/Fraction arithmetic. The displayed smallest float 4.5238558482043305e-06 was informational only, not used in the proof.
independent_exact_bound_check.inverse_generator: frontier-20261028-grid-normalized-inverse-generate.py SHA256 55e18c4070ce80ddc8e0023176e3e9b223a9c2773d83edd47797ffe03dca8563 generated a floating proposal; the integer verifier, not that proposal, establishes the bound.

limits: The radius is a deliberately conservative explicit sufficient bound, not a maximal stability radius. It describes a four-complex-parameter local projection family of one fixed 4x5 PPT state; no general 4x4 PPT/SN2 theorem, SN>=3 target witness, independent human/formal review or novelty clearance is claimed.
